combinedActivePayload.scope: Prior R3.9 cleanup of soil/WRB/JRC active paths only; not whole-application storage or memory.

r391RuntimeChanges: Mobile settings fold by default and reopen through a permanently accessible button.
Eye status stays visible independently of settings.
Actual camera optical axis now follows the eye target; turning and pitching affect rendered pixels without moving the anchor.
Shared compressed requests isolate caller cancellation; failed indexes can retry without page reload.
Transport caches are capped at two soil pairs and four environment payloads; no silent legacy raw fallback.
runtimeConstraint: Requires DecompressionStream('gzip'). Existing display sampling and regional boundaries remain. This is not a microterrain or photorealism upgrade, and real iPhone Safari/GPU/CPU verification is still pending.
principle: One semantic world score; preserve evidence identity and hashes. Current handoffs carry code, state, indexes and source locks, not historical gigabyte archives or browser binary bodies.
